messages:
ash: Planning to enable `redwood-mistral-opt-v2` in the model catalog during the Thursday change window (10:00 UTC). Need to update fallback ordering and pin a titan variant for canary. Ramp plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~3h with metric gates. Rollback plan included.

lina: ack. prefer region-staggered ramp (us-west -> eu -> apac). add perf SLOs: p95 < 180ms.

jorge: add smoke tests: 100 prompt quality eval + token inflation check. If quality regression >2% or latency >20% — immediate rollback.

ash: rollback mechanics: pin catalog back to `redwood-mistral-opt-v1` + force reroute to pinned variant, purge prefix cache TTL=0, notify @oncall and @sre. escalation: page after 5m if errors >0.5%.

sam: catalog config snippet for ops team: 
```
{
  "model_id": "redwood-mistral-opt",
  "version": "v2",
  "fallback_order": ["redwood-mistral-opt-v1", "titan-1.2", "titan-legacy"],
  "pinned_versions": {"canary": "titan-1.2"},
  "ramp": ["5%", "25%", "100%"],
  "regions": ["us-west", "eu-central", "apac-sg"]
}
```

lina: also include quantization note (int8) in release notes and SDK hints for clients.

deploy-bot: scheduled catalog-enable job 1795014000 by ash for 2026-04-02T10:00:00Z :rocket:

sre-bot: created playbook https://wiki.redwood/ops/catalog-rollouts/1795012345 :clipboard:

ash: I'll kick off the canary at 10:00 UTC. tagging: @lina @jorge @sam. I'll monitor dashboards and post quick updates here :eyes:

deploy-bot: job started at 1795014000 :in_progress:

deploy-bot: job completed at 1795015420 — enabled `redwood-mistral-opt-v2` in us-west canary (5%) :white_check_mark:

lina: saw p95 162ms, error rate 0.02% in canary — holding ramp for 30m.

jorge: quality check pass (0.6% regression on eval set) — within threshold.

ash: thanks all. proceeding to 25% in 30m if metrics stay green. release notes draft: "Enable redwood-mistral-opt v2; updated fallback ordering; canary pinned to titan-1.2; int8 quantization profile noted."
